qualifier: renal cell proliferation and organ size
name: Regulation of metanephric kidney growth and cell proliferation
rationale: All members regulate kidney/metanephros development, and the theme is distinguished from its apoptosis-, mesenchyme- and nephric-duct-focused neighbours by its emphasis on renal cell proliferation, glomerular growth and kidney size.

core: MECP2 transcriptional regulation and neurodevelopmental behavior
qualifier: vocal, social and sensorimotor behaviors
name: MECP2 transcriptional regulation and vocal, social, sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 activity, its loss-of-function variants and HDAC corepressor action with Rett-relevant behaviors (vocalization, social and observational learning, prepulse inhibition), which separates the theme from behavior-only and MECP2-memory neighbours.

qualifier: nephric duct and ureter formation
name: Nephric duct, ureter and kidney development regulation
rationale: All members concern kidney development, and the theme differs from ureteric-bud and nephron-proliferation neighbours by its nephric duct, mesonephros, epithelial tube and ureter morphogenesis members.

qualifier: self-renewal and population maintenance
name: Hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal and population maintenance
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, division, differentiation balance and maintenance (including LIF response), which distinguishes the theme from neighbours centred on erythroid, megakaryocytic or bone marrow cell-number programs.

qualifier: His–Purkinje and AV node conduction
name: Cardiac muscle depolarization and His–Purkinje conduction signaling
rationale: All members concern depolarization of atrial, ventricular or AV node myocytes and conduction-system cell signaling, separating the theme from repolarization-phase and SA-node pacemaker neighbours.

core: Hormonal regulation of islet hormone secretion
qualifier: GPCR-cAMP signaling via incretin, glucagon and calcitonin-family receptors
name: GPCR-cAMP hormone signaling controlling islet insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members are peptide and lipid GPCR pathways (incretins, glucagon, amylin/CGRP, somatostatin, free fatty acid receptors) driving cAMP signaling that regulates insulin, glucagon and growth hormone secretion, distinguishing the theme from PKA-metabolic, KATP-channel and ghrelin/relaxin neighbours.

qualifier: granulocyte and mast cell lineage commitment
name: Myeloid progenitor commitment to granulocyte and mast cell lineages
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor proliferation and differentiation toward neutrophils, eosinophils and mast cells (G-CSF, GM-CSF, promyelocyte programs) while restraining monocyte/macrophage fates, unlike the erythroid-megakaryocyte, monocyte-macrophage and RUNX-family neighbours.

qualifier: striatum and amygdala development, sensorimotor gating
name: Sensorimotor, vocal and social behavior with striatum–amygdala development
rationale: Members are sensory, vocal, social and psychomotor behaviors plus striatum and amygdala development, which separates the theme from the MECP2-mechanism, mating/aggression and locomotor-motor neighbours.

qualifier: omega-3-derived resolvins and protectins
name: Resolvin and protectin biosynthesis from omega-3 fatty acids
rationale: All members are biosynthesis of D- and E-series resolvins and protectins, distinguishing the theme from arachidonate-derived lipoxin, HETE and leukotriene neighbours.

qualifier: tract- and neuron-type-specific pathfinding and midline crossing
name: Axon pathfinding of specific tracts and midline crossing
rationale: Members are axon guidance processes defined by target tract or neuron type (commissural, retinal, corticospinal, monoaminergic) and midline choice points, unlike neighbours defined by ephrin, netrin, L1 or SLIT/ROBO signaling machinery.

qualifier: androgen receptor and prostate epithelium
name: Androgen receptor-led sex steroid transcriptional response
rationale: Members are androgen and estrogen response programs, steroid receptor chaperoning and prostate epithelial AR signaling, with the androgen/prostate component distinguishing the theme from estrogen- and RUNX2-centred neighbours.

qualifier: FcεRI-triggered calcium mobilization
name: Mast cell activation, degranulation and FcεRI calcium mobilization
rationale: All members concern mast cell differentiation, activation, degranulation and histamine release in type I hypersensitivity, and FcεRI calcium mobilization separates it from FcεRI MAPK/NF-kB and eosinophil/Th2 neighbours.

qualifier: COPII cargo loading and vesicle tethering
name: COPII vesicle cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi tethering
rationale: All members concern COPII-mediated ER export, cargo concentration and vesicle targeting/tethering to the Golgi, distinguishing the theme from COPI retrograde and intra-Golgi neighbours.

qualifier: IL-10, Th1 and T-cell cytokine restraint
name: Immunoregulatory control of inflammatory and T-cell cytokine production
rationale: Members mostly restrain production of inflammatory and T-cell cytokines (IL-1b, IL-6, IL-12, IL-2, IL-21, TNF) and Th1 responses with IL-10 regulation, which differs from neighbours centred on NF-kB/TLR signaling or direct T-cell activation suppression.

qualifier: nucleobase/nucleoside salvage and PRPP supply
name: Purine salvage, PRPP supply and nucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members cover purine nucleobase and nucleoside salvage, PRPP synthesis and ribonucleoside catabolism with their enzyme defects, distinguishing the theme from de novo purine synthesis and deoxynucleotide-triphosphate catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: nicotinic and G-protein-gated channels
name: Nicotinic and G-protein-gated ion channel modulation of synaptic excitability
rationale: Members are ion channel mechanisms setting synaptic membrane potential (nicotinic receptors, GIRK and Gβγ-inhibited calcium channels, presynaptic kainate, extrasynaptic GABA), with nicotinic receptors distinguishing it from AMPA/kainate and presynaptic-release neighbours.

core: Solute carrier transport of organic ions
qualifier: dicarboxylate/tricarboxylate and TCA intermediate transport
name: Solute carrier transport of TCA intermediates and organic ions
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of di/tricarboxylates, pyruvate, malate-aspartate shuttle and organic anions/cations (with proximal tubule development), distinguishing the theme from amino acid, monocarboxylate and carnitine/glucose transport neighbours.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 in T cells
name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 cytokine signaling in T cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 receptor signaling with STAT5 and T-cell activation programs, distinguishing the theme from IL-3/IL-5, IL-6 family and IL-15/IL-21 NK-cell neighbours.

qualifier: dystrophin complex and neuromuscular junction assembly
name: Skeletal muscle differentiation, dystrophin complex and neuromuscular junction assembly
rationale: Members cover myogenesis, muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex formation and NMJ acetylcholine receptor clustering, separating it from sarcomere-contraction, DAG1-glycosylation, atrophy and basement-membrane neighbours.

qualifier: synaptic vesicle endocytosis and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis
name: Clathrin coat cycling in endocytosis and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis
rationale: Members concern clathrin coat assembly, cargo loading and disassembly in endocytosis and synaptic vesicle recycling plus melanosome and platelet dense granule biogenesis, unlike Golgi-lysosome, mitochondrial and presynaptic-structure neighbours.

qualifier: synthesis, transport and receptor signaling
name: Leukotriene biosynthesis, transport and receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover leukotriene (mainly cysteinyl) synthesis, transport and receptor-mediated signaling, distinguishing the theme from leukotriene/lipoxin catabolism and prostanoid/histamine receptor neighbours.

qualifier: synthesis, Golgi transport and GPI anchoring
name: Nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis, Golgi transport and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members concern synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, GDP-fucose, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucuronate, their transport into the Golgi with transporter defects, and GPI anchor synthesis, separating the theme from N-glycan, glycosphingolipid and lysosomal glycan neighbours that build or degrade the glycans themselves.

qualifier: complex III–IV electron transfer and complex IV assembly
name: Late respiratory chain electron transfer and complex IV assembly
rationale: Members cover ubiquinol-to-cytochrome c and cytochrome c-to-oxygen electron transfer, chemiosmotic ATP formation and complex IV/respirasome assembly, distinguishing it from complex I/III assembly and mitochondrial translation neighbours.

qualifier: blood group antigens and selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood group and selectin-ligand glycan synthesis
rationale: Members cover fucose metabolism, ABO/Lewis antigen and oligosaccharide synthesis, and protein sulfation with leukocyte rolling and HSC homing that depend on fucosylated, sulfated selectin ligands, unlike N- and O-glycan processing neighbours.

qualifier: ERAD regulation and reticulophagy
name: ERAD regulation and ER misfolded-protein quality control
rationale: Members concern response to misfolded proteins, ERAD regulation, unfolding, Josephin-domain deubiquitinases and reticulophagy, distinguishing the theme from ribosome quality control, ubiquitin chain and aggrephagy neighbours.
